items.subject: ela
items.strand: Developing and sustaining foundational language skills: listening, speaking, discussion, and thinking—oral language
items.text: listen actively and ask questions to understand information and answer questions using multi-word responses
items.ican: I can listen actively and ask questions to understand information and answer questions using multi-word responses.

items.subject: ela
items.strand: Developing and sustaining foundational language skills: listening, speaking, discussion, and thinking—oral language
items.text: restate and follow oral directions that involve a short, related sequence of actions
items.ican: I can restate and follow oral directions that involve a short, related sequence of actions.

items.subject: ela
items.strand: Developing and sustaining foundational language skills: listening, speaking, discussion, and thinking—oral language
items.text: share information and ideas by speaking audibly and clearly using the conventions of language
items.ican: I can share information and ideas by speaking audibly and clearly using the conventions of language.

items.subject: ela
items.strand: Developing and sustaining foundational language skills: listening, speaking, discussion, and thinking—oral language
items.text: work collaboratively with others by following agreed-upon rules for discussion, including taking turns
items.ican: I can work collaboratively with others by following agreed-upon rules for discussion, including taking turns.

items.subject: ela
items.strand: Developing and sustaining foundational language skills: listening, speaking, discussion, and thinking—oral language
items.text: develop social communication such as introducing himself/herself, using common greetings, and expressing needs and wants
items.ican: I can develop social communication such as introducing himself/herself, using common greetings, and expressing needs and wants.

items.subject: ela
items.strand: Developing and sustaining foundational language skills: listening, speaking, reading, writing, and thinking—beginning reading and writing
items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by identifying and producing rhyming words
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by identifying and producing rhyming words.

items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by recognizing spoken alliteration or groups of words that begin with the same spoken onset or initial sound
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by recognizing spoken alliteration or groups of words that begin with the same spoken onset or initial sound.

items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by identifying the individual words in a spoken sentence
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by identifying the individual words in a spoken sentence.

items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by identifying syllables in spoken words
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by identifying syllables in spoken words.

items.strand: Developing and sustaining foundational language skills: listening, speaking, reading, writing, and thinking—beginning reading and writing
items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by blending syllables to form multisyllabic words
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by blending syllables to form multisyllabic words.

items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by segmenting multisyllabic words into syllables
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by segmenting multisyllabic words into syllables.

items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by blending spoken onsets and rimes to form simple words
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by blending spoken onsets and rimes to form simple words.

items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by blending spoken phonemes to form one-syllable words
items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by blending spoken phonemes to form one-syllable words.

items.text: demonstrate phonological awareness by manipulating syllables within a multisyllabic word

items.ican: I can demonstrate phonological awareness by segmenting spoken one-syllable words into individual phonemes.

items.text: demonstrate and apply phonetic knowledge by identifying and matching the common sounds that letters represent

items.ican: I can demonstrate and apply phonetic knowledge by using letter-sound relationships to decode, including VC, CVC, CCVC, and CVCC words.

items.text: demonstrate and apply phonetic knowledge by recognizing that new words are created when letters are changed, added, or deleted such as it - pit - tip - tap
items.ican: I can demonstrate and apply phonetic knowledge by recognizing that new words are created when letters are changed, added, or deleted such as it - pit - tip - tap.

items.ican: I can demonstrate and apply phonetic knowledge by identifying and reading at least 25 high-frequency words from a research-based list.

items.text: demonstrate and apply spelling knowledge by spelling high-frequency words from a research-based list
